FrameIoV4TokenCredential.x-credential-instructions: Paste an existing Adobe IMS access token for Frame.io V4. Access tokens typically expire after one hour; replace the token when it expires. NoClick does not refresh it. For an eligible auto-migrated account using a legacy developer token, enable Legacy developer token to send the required x-frameio-legacy-token-auth header. Frame.io account roles determine read and write access. Connection verification reads the current user.
